$comment: Test cold-import baseline (t277). Sites where a heavy module (static import graph >= 200 modules) is imported from inside a test function ON PURPOSE, each with its reason. The list may only SHRINK: deploy/checks/check-test-cold-imports.mjs fails on a new heavy site, and on an entry whose site is gone. To remove one, give the module state a reset door in the product (owner-level) or restructure the file so the import happens at collection.

packages/server/src/agent/__tests__/t194.why: Module-level state OUTSIDE `agent/shared-state.ts` with no reset door in the product; clearing every shared-state Map/Set (the isolation that DID replace the reset in sibling suites) was tried 2026-10-24 and failed clauses of this file, so a fresh registry per clause is what isolates it. Removing it needs the product to expose reset doors (an owner-level call, no product change in t277). Measured before t277 (slowest clause / median, 3 clauses, load ~190 with 300 files running): 6.7 s / 3.1 s.

packages/server/src/agent/__tests__/the-.why: The import IS the subject (the module arms its sweeps when it is first imported) and it runs at COLLECTION through a top-level await inside the interceptor's callback; the gate sees a function boundary there, not a clause. Measured before t277 (slowest clause / median, 2 clauses, load ~190 with 300 files running): 7.9 s / 7.9 s.

packages/server/src/agent/v2/__tests__/t.why: The announce latch and counters are module state by design, so each clause needs a fresh receipt.js. Its heavy door (the tool surface and tool docs) is stubbed because every clause sends `useTools: false`, which brought the fresh import from ~13 s to ~0.4 s on a loaded machine; the gate counts the static graph and cannot see the stub. Measured before t277: first clause 13.6 s on a loaded box.

packages/server/src/costs/__tests__/t138.why: A RESTART IS THE SUBJECT: `boot()` resets the module registry on purpose so the module-held latches and watchers start empty exactly as on a real restart, and the clauses assert that the owner's cards come back from the DATABASE alone. Clearing state instead would let live in-memory state stand in for the persisted state under test, so the fresh registry cannot be removed without hollowing the test. Measured before t277 (slowest clause / median, 12 clauses, load ~190 with 300 files running): 18.0 s / 6.9 s.

packages/server/src/healer/__tests__/com.why: Restart simulation by design (t265 left it): a fresh registry IS a restart there, and the clauses `vi.doMock` the transport per clause, which a static import cannot express. Measured before t277 (slowest clause / median, 11 clauses, load ~190 with 300 files running): 11.0 s / 3.9 s.
